posts.text: This is why i love marketing 😁

I had been building in Web3 initially with experiences,jobs,trades but it wasn’t structured and I wasn’t fully committed.

I was so inconsistent, I didn’t even have a CV.

That was what I used the whole of 2025 to figure out.

A whole year.

Was figuring what skill to learn, where to position myself, where to start my career and how to go about every other thing.

I wouldn’t have gone through all those stress if I had GradFill 

If I knew GradFill then, I would not look for a job because they would definitely find me a job and refer me to different employers.

You don’t have to do anything basically, just become a part of Gradfill, once they have your profile and start posting alerts that suit your interests, just apply and you’ll be waiting for a job through their influence.

Before you read another “educational LinkedIn post” read this! 

I didn’t understand the meaning of “PRACTICAL” until I started working at Scribble Network  

Jack ma said he noticed when his professionals go to business schools, they become dull.

This is the founder of Alibaba Group  

Opeyemi Adesina  also said he had dropped out of two business schools because of this same reason and the only reason why he’s succeeding at his current one is because he has experiential knowledge of business already.

That is because it’s all “Theoretical” and all on paper in business school.

Doing the business itself would teach you lessons you can never learn in the 4 walls of a classroom.

These are two great founders running a successful business.

How did that connect?

I had worked at several organizations but they’re softly compared to what I’m learning & doing at Scribble Network.

I could write about Business Development from today till tomorrow but that is all theoretical.

The practical aspect is doing the job itself with world class tools which is what I am doing right now.

I have learnt most of them for a long while, but handling real tasks with them is a totally different ball game.

Every lessons you will learn about business mostly comes from doing the business.

Start DO-ing today!
